description.value: Burger & Cafe Joy is a Japanese-inspired burger cafe that has been operating inside Sahali Mall in Kamloops since 2011, where owners Ben and Peiting make every burger from scratch using locally sourced meats, house-made sauces, and fresh vegetables. The menu blends North American comfort food with Japanese flavours — think teriyaki beef, pork katsu, oyster burgers, and yakisoba sides — alongside bubble tea and homemade Asian desserts. A touring cyclist can call ahead for takeout and head straight to pickup, or have the meal delivered to a nearby stop.

address.value: 945 Columbia Street West, Unit 140, Kamloops, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at burgerjoy.ca confirms the business name, phone (778-471-1666), and location inside Sahali Mall at 945 Columbia Street West, consistent with all OSM data. Takeout is explicitly advertised via call-ahead pickup and third-party delivery; vegetarian options are confirmed by both OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes tag and the menu listing Spicy Tofu, Teriyaki Tofu, Veggie-So, and vegetarian spring rolls. No bike parking, washroom details, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those are marked null.
